== Course of events ==

Having been brought before Glinda, who sits on her throne of rubies, Dorothy recounts her whole story and tells Glinda that her greatest wish is to return to Kansas to Aunt Em and Uncle Henry. In response, Glinda agrees to help her, but asks for the Golden Cap in exchange. Dorothy willingly gives up the Golden Cap to Glinda.

With the Golden Cap now hers, Glinda explains that the Silver Shoes can carry their wearer anywhere in three steps, simply by clicking the heels together three times and naming the destination, and she reveals that Dorothy's Silver Shoes could have carried her home to Kansas from the very first day. Glinda then uses the Golden Cap's three remaining commands to send the Winged Monkeys to carry the Scarecrow to the Emerald City, the Tin Woodman to the Winkies, and the Lion to his forest.
